test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Were this boy / washing his clothes / yesterday when the matron / came for a regular round?
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"Were this boy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"Were this boy."**
 
• The error is in the subject-verb agreement.
 
• According to the subject-verb agreement, a singular subject always takes a singular verb, and a plural subject takes a plural verb.
 
• The sentence should begin with **"Was" **instead of **"Were" **as the subject is singular (boy).
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: ***Was this boy**__ washing his clothes yesterday when the matron came for a regular round?*
